claims.canonical_statement: Current first-party/source video evidence supports multiple Sideway frame representations rather than one universal OHLC formula. claims.canonical_statement: EP.5 teaches Body Collection as a forecast-zone method built from ซอก + ไส้ + คู่, not as one exact entry price. Headed source-video review now visually closes the shown ซอก form as a same-color close/open body junction and the shown คู่ forms as opposite-color reversal pairs sharing a close/open equilibrium level at support/resistance. In the worked PA Sell example, คู่ and ซอก share the upper forecast reference (~3563.59) while a wick-derived second reference participates in the lower forecast level (~3560.31), forming the demonstrated interval. Use same-timeframe structure first; if unavailable, fall back one timeframe (H4->H1 and, when still incomplete, H1->M30). Zone arrival alone is insufficient: lower-timeframe PA aligned with the H4 thesis and brake/confirmation context are required before entry consideration; no PA means no entry even inside the zone. Normal Body Collection is distinct from Sideway entry handling.
